correctness.rationale: Exact inverse compatibility equation is necessary and sufficient for positive four-census host histories. Two distinct positive triples yield all four host values by elementary recurrence substitution. Exact derivative identity and 1/2<log2<1 give two simple inverse roots, so the implicit function theorem proves a genuine open set. A fifth-census ratio is computed exactly and the independent script replays these steps; numerical tests are not substituted for the proof.
